responsibility: Defines the main MIR builder for `rustc_mir_build::build`, orchestrating THIR-to-MIR construction for functions and consts, owning the builder state and shared lowering context, selecting custom versus standard MIR construction, enforcing prerequisite analyses, and wiring together the block, expression, scope, match, coverage, and utility submodules.
same_name_distinction: Unlike the more specialized `mod.rs` files under `build/*` and `thir/*`, this is the top-level standard MIR-construction module: it defines `Builder`, the `mir_build` entry point, and wires together the whole lowering pipeline rather than focusing on one subproblem like expressions, matches, custom MIR parsing, or THIR creation.
